# 🚀 LinkedIn HR Finder - Improved Workflow

## Features:
✅ **Simple Input**: Just enter company name
✅ **Free Sources**: Google Custom Search + Proxycurl
✅ **AI-Powered**: GPT-4/Claude message generation
✅ **Project Integration**: Auto-includes your portfolio
✅ **Complete Profiles**: Name, title, location, LinkedIn URL
✅ **Ready-to-Send**: Personalized messages for each contact

## How to Use:
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/linkedin-hr-finder \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "company_name": "Google",
    "max_results": 20,
    "your_name": "Your Name",
    "your_role": "Software Engineer",
    "your_experience": "5 years",
    "your_skills": "Python, React, AWS, Docker",
    "your_projects": [
      {"name": "E-Commerce Platform", "description": "Built scalable platform serving 100K users", "tech": "React, Node.js, MongoDB"},
      {"name": "AI Chatbot", "description": "Developed intelligent customer service bot", "tech": "Python, OpenAI, FastAPI"}
    ]
  }'
```

## Free API Limits:
- Google Custom Search: 100 searches/day
- Proxycurl: 10-15 free credits (3 credits per employee)
- OpenAI/Anthropic: Your API key required

## 🔍 Method 1: Google Custom Search API

**Pros:**
- 100 free searches per day
- No login required
- Fast and reliable
- Finds public profiles

**Setup:**
1. Get API key: console.cloud.google.com
2. Create Custom Search Engine
3. Add credentials to n8n

**Alternative:** Use Method 2 (Proxycurl) if quota exceeded

## 🔍 Method 2: Proxycurl API

**Pros:**
- 10-15 free trial credits
- Rich profile data
- Employee listing by company
- Role filtering

**Costs:**
- 3 credits per employee returned
- Employee Count: 1 credit
- Full Profile: 1 credit

**Setup:**
1. Sign up at nubela.co/proxycurl
2. Get API key
3. Add credentials to n8n

*Disabled by default - enable as alternative*

## 💎 Profile Enrichment (Optional)

**What it does:**
- Gets detailed profile data
- Email, phone (if public)
- Work history
- Skills and education

**Cost:** 1 credit per profile

*Disabled by default to save credits*
*Enable if you need detailed data*

## 🤖 AI Message Generation

**Choose your AI provider:**

✅ **OpenAI (GPT-4)** - Enabled by default
- Great creativity
- Natural language
- API key required

⚪ **Anthropic (Claude)** - Disabled
- More professional tone
- Detailed messages
- API key required

**Enable one, disable the other**

**What it does:**
- Personalizes each message
- References their role/company
- Highlights your relevant projects
- Creates 2 versions: short (connection) + long (follow-up)

## 📤 Export Options

**Formats:**
✅ JSON - Complete data with messages
✅ CSV - Spreadsheet format

**Files Include:**
- Name, Title, Company, Location
- LinkedIn Profile URL
- Your profile/projects info
- Connection request (short)
- Follow-up message (detailed)
- Metadata (timestamps, AI provider)

**File naming:**
`linkedin_hr_CompanyName_2025-01-15.json`

## 🎯 Quick Start Guide

**1. Setup (One-time)**
- Get Google Custom Search API key (free)
- Optional: Get Proxycurl API key (10-15 free credits)
- Get OpenAI or Anthropic API key
- Add credentials to n8n

**2. Prepare Your Data**
- List your projects with descriptions
- Your skills and experience
- Your target role

**3. Run Workflow**
- Send POST request with company name
- Wait for results (30-60 seconds)
- Get JSON/CSV with all contacts + messages

**4. Review & Send**
- Review generated messages
- Customize if needed
- Send connection requests
- Use follow-up messages after acceptance

**Tips:**
- Start with 10-20 results
- Test messages before bulk sending
- Respect LinkedIn's connection limits
- Personalize further for best results
